entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production TERRAIN-ONLY full-map background for an existing 2D pixel-art RPG. Edit target image 1 is the existing WINTER VILLAGE map overview, exact 52:46 aspect ratio. Image 2 is a strict topology guide, not artwork to reproduce. Deliver 1664x1472 or higher in precisely the same aspect ratio. Keep the original overhead three-quarter RPG view, full-map framing, every riverbank, stone-road junction, bridge/deck, staircase, and blocked-cliff position registered to the existing pixels. DO NOT redesign the map layout or make an island. REMOVE ALL existing houses, roofs, gates, individual trees, bushes, fences, benches, lamps, wells, garden beds, barrels, rocks, signs, portals, fire, objects, labels and characters: these are separately rendered by the game and must not be baked into this image. Fill their former footprints seamlessly with the same walkable snow or flat flagstone present around them. KEEP the three existing right-side wooden crossings/decks and the stairs through the north cliff exactly where they are, since these are terrain routes. Preserve broad snow fields, central stone plaza and branching streets. The long right river and the horizontal slate cliff band at about 20-28% image height are the ONLY actual deep divisions: improve that existing cliff band with coherent layered vertical slate faces, worn icy strata, a convincing frozen waterfall where the river crosses it, snow-capped upper ledge and cast shadow within the already blocked band. Do not add new cliff borders around the outer map: those snow edges are traversable. New far-depth details only inside existing blocked rock/water footprint, subtle dark blue water depth and ice shelf underneath original shore. Elegant quiet winter fantasy, pale blue-white snow, slate lavender stone, restrained cold teal water, crystalline ice highlights. Dense clean pixel clusters, fine authored pixel-art stone edges and snow shapes, limited stepped values; no blur, photographic smoothing, noisy grain or hazy overlay. Terrain silhouette and all route positions MUST remain unchanged. No text/UI/grid/map pins/canvas border, no houses or freestanding trees. This will be layered beneath all existing game objects.
entries.review: Viewed generated image. Individual trees/buildings/props removed; river, bridge/decks, central staircase and connected stone streets retained. Further runtime shoreline registration QA remains.
